Released on 9 Feb 2022 Seven Wonders: Chapter 2.5 Update

collect/craft the following

#1 Defeat Henry Every for a chance to get Aurangzeb's Ring
#2 Defeat Mohri Motonari for a chance to get Hyakuman-Isshin Banner
#3 Defeat Peter the Great for a chance to get Royal Easter Egg

#4 After defeating Henry Every craft Pirate King's Coin
#5 After defeating Mohri Motonari craft Tosenkyo
#6 After defeating Peter the Great craft Monomakh's Cap

Gets Legendary Coat for completing the MA
